alive.last_commit_message:
feat(engine): diff-based regression hunting via cbh diff + /diff (#239)

* feat(engine): diff-based regression hunting via cbh diff + /diff

Add a deterministic recon-snapshot diff engine so re-testing a target finds
only what changed since the last run, instead of re-reading cleared surface.

- engine/diff.py — pure-function diff over two manifest.json dicts (no HTTP,
  no LLM judgment): new assets, new ranked-surface entries, tech-stack drift,
  status-code flips, newly flagged secrets.
- cbh diff <target> [--no-save] [--manifest PATH] — writes
  recon/<target>/REGRESSION.md and advances the snapshot baseline under
  recon/<target>/.snapshots/.
- commands/diff.md — /diff slash command wrapping cbh diff with triage
  guidance.
- skills/regression-hunting/SKILL.md — workflow, cadence for continuous-scope
  programs, and triage priority (secrets first, status-flips next, etc.).
- engine/test_diff.py — 11 unit tests (full engine suite: 114/114 passing).
- Sync skill/command counts to 85 skills / 16 commands across README,
  CHANGELOG, docs/architecture.md, docs/credits.md, docs/skills.md, etc.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
